d:
Anant Singh ke ghar beti ki shadi ki taiyariyan jor-shor se chal rahi hain. lekin mausam ne in taiyariyon ke samne chunauti khari kar di hai. barish ki aashanka ke bich parivar aur aayojan se jure log taiyariyon men jute hain. kya barish shadi ke jashn men khalal dalegi? dekhie puri riporta.
About Channel:
ABP Bihar pradesh ki khabron ka ek aisa chainal hai jahan pradesh se juri har khabar aapke pas sabse pahle pahunchti hai. bihar ki rajniti, bihar ki barh, lalu - nitish ka ek dusre par palatvar, apradh ki andruni khabar aapke pas tathyon ke sath lekar aata hai.
